A colourful one-page mind map titled "Figures of Speech". A central circle reads "Figures of speech". Five branches, each a different soft colour: "Comparison" (simile, metaphor, personification), "Exaggeration and softening" (hyperbole, understatement, litotes, euphemism), "Contrast" (irony, sarcasm, oxymoron, paradox, antithesis), "Association" (metonymy, synecdoche), "Sound" (alliteration, assonance, onomatopoeia).
